newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks reverse losses, helped by bonds.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks reverse losses, helped by bonds.

text.p: Madrid stocks overturned early losses to close flat on Thursday helped by bond strength, but trade was in general fairly dull, dealers said.
The general index up 0.06 points, 0.02 percent, to 391.41 Ibex down 1.34 points, 0.03 percent, to 4,511.57.
Repsol continued to catch up with the rest of the market, adding 45 pesetas to 4,435.
Aguas de Barcelona shed 70 pesetas to 5,080. Market sources said IBV was to sell 2.3 million shares in the stock.
Range-trading at around these levels was seen until new factors spur more gains. Nevertheless, the tone is firm, dealers said.

Tomorrow's Bank of Spain repo was said to be unlikely to produce a fresh rate cut, but, as ever, no-one was ruling it out, especially after comments by the central bank governor today that inflation could end the year around 3.3 percent.
But in general the bank is thought likely to stay on hold until November inflation data is released.
